# Test face images

All images are works of NASA and are in the **public domain** in the United
States (17 U.S.C. § 105). They were downscaled to a maximum of 480 px.

| File | Person | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `ride_1984.jpg` | Sally Ride | Wikimedia Commons, `File:Sally Ride (1984).jpg` (NASA) |
| `ride_1979.jpg` | Sally Ride | Wikimedia Commons, `File:Sally Ride 1979.jpg` (NASA) |
| `armstrong_1964.jpg` | Neil Armstrong | Wikimedia Commons, `File:Neil Armstrong 1964 portrait.jpg` (NASA) |
| `armstrong_pose.jpg` | Neil Armstrong | Wikimedia Commons, `File:Neil Armstrong pose.jpg` (NASA) |
| `collins.jpg` | Eileen Collins | scikit-image `astronaut.png` (NASA, public domain) |

They are used only to check that face matching accepts two different photos
of the same person and rejects photos of different people. Do not use them
for anything that implies endorsement by the people shown or by NASA.
